# Share2Save — Offline Video & Audio Library for iOS
> iOS app that turns any link into a personal offline media library. Save videos and audio for offline viewing. Developed by Lorenz Maierhofer.

Share2Save is your personal offline media library for iPhone and iPad. Share any link with video or audio to the app and it downloads the media for offline viewing — no buffering, no data connection needed. Useful for flights, commutes, and low-connectivity travel. Completely free, with no account, no ads, and no tracking.

## App Features
- Personal offline media library with Video and Audio tabs, folders, and search
- One-tap save from Safari, Chrome, or Firefox via the iOS share sheet
- Background downloads (iOS Background URL Session) with Live Activity progress on the Lock Screen
- Built-in player with playback queue, shuffle, resume, and Picture in Picture
- Quality control: best available, 1080p MP4, 720p, or audio-only
- Convert and organize saved media
- 100% local storage — nothing uploaded, no analytics, no account
- Works with a broad range of video/audio URLs; DRM-protected platforms are not supported
- Localized in 10+ languages
